what: The question writer's cold-solve checker (claude-opus-5-5, effort high) rated Reading and Writing questions whose official difficulty is known. Counts only; no question text.
conclusion: The checker rates about one level low. For Reading and Writing, a 2 matches an official hard question and a 1 matches medium or easy, so hard R&W questions need a rating of 2 or higher (HARD_BAR_RW). Math is not calibrated yet and keeps a bar of 3.
